self_review.method: Author checked headline-bound wording, semantic source windows, actual versus preview status, card dates and units, investment triggers and consistency. This is not an independent review receipt.
self_review.timing: China October PMI, BOJ decision, Polish October flash CPI, US PCE and official US payroll outcome are not treated as actual. The US election remains pending. Microsoft, Meta, Coinbase and Carvana October 30 evening earnings are actual before midnight UTC, but no prior regular-close reaction is attributed to their evening results. Japan September production is an early-local October 31 release at 08:50 JST, or October 30 23:50 UTC, eligible strictly before cutoff.
self_review.market_discipline: Every quoted market level/return is from October 30 completed own-session card. Crypto uses completed UTC daily candle. Treasury percentages/bps exactly match official curve and move labels. No numeric spot-FX, no WDC/CMCSA levels, no computed ratios or rescaled prices.
self_review.claims: Concrete claims are confined to own-date headlines/card. Forecasts and plans remain prospective; lawsuits, requests for investigation and charges remain distinct from rulings or guilt. Flow claims rely on specific positioning or fund reports, not inferred from returns.
self_review.citation_room: Maximum three nonretail uses for n2102; every other citation at most two. Separate retail one-use citations can fit combined cap4.
